summary.headline: Astrology and Ancient Culture
summary.text: Historical discussion of the neglect and later value of Greek astrological writings after the sixteenth century, emphasizing astrology’s role in understanding religion, science, ancient mathematics, and Greek and Roman culture. Ptolemy and Paulus Alexandrinus are cited as authorities.
